email.subject: compliance automation at resend
email.body: Hi Bu, I noticed that Resend is currently hiring for a Security Engineer, Platform role to support your growing infrastructure. As you scale to support enterprise customers like MrBeast and Replit, maintaining your existing SOC 2 and GDPR posture alongside new frameworks like ISO 27001 often creates significant operational overhead. Sprinto automates this process by connecting directly to your cloud, HR, and code tools to collect evidence and monitor controls continuously. This allows your engineering team to focus on building your email platform rather than manual compliance tasks. Would you be open to a brief conversation about how we can help manage your compliance posture as you grow?
